about: Proposed numbers for a greenery pass in the lab (D-143), by place. Spacing, distances, group sizes and shares come from corpus-greenery.json (the corpus, D-136); 'source' names the table. Where the corpus has no numbers (roads, junctions, stages) the value is a proposal, marked 'proposal', to be tuned against renders and Tyler's review. Nothing here is built. Prefab lists per biome come from vanilla-greenery.json and avoid food-bearing plants on the village side until the mod skips landscaping (see docs/handoffs/2026-11-10-design/landscaping.md, 'For the mod session').

tag.piece_field: landscape: true on every greenery piece the pass places (and on yards.js plants), kept with the piece through the blueprint
tag.blueprint_section: #VillheimLandscape: indices of landscape pieces in the file's #Pieces list, written beside #VillheimClips
tag.mod_key: villheim_landscape (ZDO int 1), set by DesignSpawner on spawn; gatherers, foragers and clearing skip it

biome_prefabs.about: Low-risk prefabs first (no Pickable, no TreeBase). Trees are TreeBase and need the mod's skip before they go in a village; berry bushes, crops and herbs are Pickable food or herbs and need it too.

on_house_vines.patches: one patch per wall face that gets vines; 0.05 vines per wall piece at the median, 0.15 at p75 (vines.on_wall_per_wall_piece), so a house carries one or two patches
on_house_vines.where: an outside corner first (38 % of vines are at a corner), then along a face in a line (275 line groups)
on_house_vines.keep_clear: door and window openings, chimney and smoke outlets, the 2 m in front of a door

foot_of_walls.share_of_builds: flower against a wall 42, bush 54, tree 25 of 609 builds with greenery
foot_of_walls.group: singles and pairs; flowers in short runs of 2 to 4
foot_of_walls.rule_kept: yards.js: nothing over 1 m tall within 1.2 m of the walls (eaves and braces)

window_boxes_and_sills.share_of_builds: pot raised by a wall 54, flower raised by a wall 24, bush raised by a wall 51
window_boxes_and_sills.group: pots in clusters of 2 to 3 of mixed kinds (288 mixed pot groups)
window_boxes_and_sills.now_in_lab: details.js window boxes from d2: board box under ground-floor front windows with Pickable_Dandelion

porch_and_eaves.share_of_builds: flower 77, bush 92, pot 63 under eaves or porch
porch_and_eaves.what: pots and low flowers beside the door and along porch edges; Norse builds lead this place (flower 18 and bush 16 of 63 Norse builds)

yards.groups: bushes: mostly single (1,899 singles, 422 pairs, 274 clusters of 3 to 6); 38 % of multi-bush groups mix prefabs
yards.trees: 0 or 1 small tree per yard at s2, up to 2 at s3, 2.8 m apart at least, scaled 0.5 to 1.0 (79 % of corpus trees are scaled, 0.49 to 1.46)
yards.now_in_lab: yards.js d3: 2 or 3 bushes 1.4 m in from the fence and 3 m apart; dandelions along the walls

gardens_and_beds.share_of_builds: crop in 23 of 609 builds; flower groups of 3 or more with a low border 29, crop 11
gardens_and_beds.rows: 12 of 85 crop groups lie in a line; beds of 3 to 8 plants
gardens_and_beds.where: the yard side away from the street (Manor Lords backyard), against a sunny wall
gardens_and_beds.now_in_lab: yards.js d2 beds: 2 by 1 m beam border, 3 plants 0.55 m apart

courtyards.what: denser than yards: a tree or a bed in the middle, bushes and flowers in the corners and along the walls, the walking lines kept clear

road_edges.share_of_builds: bush 25, flower 15, tree 6 at a path edge
road_edges.proposal: verge plants in short runs with gaps (one plant per 3 to 6 m of road at s2, one per 2 to 3 m at s3), both sides uneven, never on the road; heavier where a road meets a wall, fence or rock

junctions.corpus: no numbers (9 village builds; few laid roads)
junctions.proposal: on the outside corner of a junction: one tree (s3) or a bush cluster of 2 to 4 with flowers at its foot (s2), set back 1.5 m from both road edges; the inside of the turn and the 2 m sight line along each road kept clear

open_ground.share_of_builds: tree 75, bush 88, flower 79 on grounds over 10 m from walls
open_ground.what: single trees and loose bush groups between houses, kept from the clearing or planted back; village builds put most of their trees here (145 weighted pieces)

stages.about: Proposal: the corpus has no stage data. Counts are per house unless noted.

s1.yard: no yard (yards start at s2, D-060 B)
s1.village: trees left standing by the clearing stay; no planting

s2.vines: one patch on 1 house in 4 (corpus 0.27), up to the median 23 pieces
s2.yard: 1 to 3 bushes, 0 to 1 tree, beds as yards.js

s3.vines: patches on 2 faces of older houses, up to p75 64 pieces
s3.yard: cared-for garden: beds in rows, flowers along the walls, a tree
s3.junctions: a tree at the main junction

variance.culture: from corpus by_culture: castle and norse-forest builds put vines on walls most; norse builds put flowers and bushes under eaves and porches and pots indoors; medieval-timber builds put flowers against walls; ashlands builds use pots; yards.js CULTURE_YARD already gives Frankish, Anglo-Saxon and Byzantine a second bed
variance.village: proposal: one roll per village for how green it is (vine share 0.15 to 0.4, density 0.6 to 1.4 times)
variance.household: persona.hobby.plants raises beds, pots and window flowers; persona.tidy picks cared-for (lines, borders, even spacing) or wild (masses, mixed prefabs, vines high); persona.yard work and plain keep beds out as today
